scope: Priority A only: twelve multi-provider observed competition entries with country context.
interpretation: External official competition evidence supports the public competition identity and season context. It does not prove that provider-specific IDs or season IDs refer to the same canonical competition or season.

entries.name: Bundesliga

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 Bundesliga calendar; start 28 August 2026.
DFL competition regulations identify Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga as licensed leagues.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Cross-provider 2026 start-year overlap for football-data.org, OpenFootball and OpenLigaDB; Bzzoiro season label is 26/27 but lacks parsed start year.

entries.name: Premier League

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 club list and confirms the Championship is the second tier below the Premier League.
Official 2026/27 fixture list; includes Aston Villa v Sunderland on 21 November and Hull City v Brighton & Hove Albion on 22 November.
Official November amendment notice; confirms the two reviewed fixture pairings and states all listed kick-offs are GMT and 15:00 unless otherwise stated.

entries.provider_season_evidence: OpenFootball and OpenLigaDB share 2026 start-year evidence; Bzzoiro season label is 26/27 without parsed start year.

entries.name: Ligue 1

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 Ligue 1 calendar, season dates, matchday structure and scheduled fixtures.
Official announcement explicitly refers to the 18 clubs of Ligue 1 for 2026/27.
Official LFP French-language calendar announcement dated 10 June 2026.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Bzzoiro's 2026/27 season label is explicit; OpenFootball's 2026-27 label and football-data.org's 2026-08-22 date are consistent with the official season start but do not prove provider season-ID equivalence. Bzzoiro has 34 timezone-aware observations, 9 unique fixtures and all 18 official team names in its bounded sample. OpenFootball has 6,120 observations and 306 unique fixtures, but its kickoff values are local/date-only without timezone and some are missing. football-data.org has 10 timezone-aware observations covering 12 teams, but country is missing on all 10. No exact UTC cross-provider fixture overlap was established.

entries.name: Championship

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 Championship competition page and live table showing 24 participating clubs.
Official 2026/27 fixture release; opening weekend 14–16 August 2026 and Championship final day 1 May 2027.
Official announcement of fixture release date and opening weekend.
EFL regulations state that the Championship and League One each consist of 24 clubs.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Both provider labels descriptively identify 2026/27 (Bzzoiro 'Championship 26/27'; OpenFootball '2026-27'). The current raw-observation audit has 45 Bzzoiro observations across 24 teams and 12 unique fixture IDs, all with timezone-aware kickoffs; OpenFootball has 11,040 observations, 552 unique fixtures and 24 teams, but its kickoffs are local date/time values without timezone. No exact UTC cross-provider fixture overlap was established.

entries.name: 2. Bundesliga

DFL regulations identify 2. Bundesliga as a licensed league.

entries.provider_season_evidence: OpenLigaDB season year 2026; Bzzoiro season label is 26/27 without parsed start year.

entries.name: Serie A

external_evidence.supports: Official Serie A 2026/27 season dates; distinguishes Serie A from Coppa Italia.
Official announcement identifies 20 clubs, 38 matchdays and 380 matches, and gives the season dates.
Official 2026/27 fixture-list publication dated 5 June 2026.
Official Matchday 12 fixture listing for 21–23 November 2026.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Both source labels normalize descriptively to 2026/27 (Bzzoiro 'Serie A 26/27'; OpenFootball '2026-27'). Bzzoiro has 21 raw observations, 9 unique fixture IDs, and 18 observed teams; OpenFootball has 7,600 raw observations, 380 unique fixtures, and all 20 official teams, but its sampled kickoffs are local-time values without timezone. No exact UTC cross-provider fixture overlap was established.

entries.name: Eredivisie

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 calendar sets the season start weekend of 7–9 August 2026 and final matchday on 23 May 2027.
Official competition model describes the Eredivisie as the Netherlands' highest level with 18 teams.
Official 2026/27 club branding page identifies the 18 participating VriendenLoterij Eredivisie clubs.
Official definitive 2026/27 fixture programme with matchday dates, clubs and kick-off times.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Bzzoiro labels the season 'Eredivisie 26/27'; OpenFootball labels it '2026-27'. The current raw-observation audit has 24 Bzzoiro observations across 18 teams and 9 unique fixture IDs, all timezone-aware; OpenFootball has 6,120 observations, 306 unique fixtures and 18 teams, but includes 2,000 date-only and 4,120 local-time-without-timezone kickoff observations. No exact UTC cross-provider fixture overlap was established.

entries.name: MLS
entries.external_competition_type: men's top-flight professional league spanning the United States and Canada

external_evidence.supports: Official MLS profile identifies MLS as the top-flight professional league in the United States and Canada, with 30 clubs in 2026.
Official 2026 competition guidelines list 30 clubs across two conferences and specify 34 regular-season matches per club.
Official 2026 regular-season schedule and key dates, including 21 February opening weekend and 7 November Decision Day.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Both providers identify the 2026 calendar-year season. The current raw-observation audit has 35 Bzzoiro timezone-aware observations across 12 teams and 6 unique fixtures; LiveScoreFootball has 22 timezone-aware observations across 4 teams and 2 unique fixtures. No exact cross-provider fixture overlap was established. The official MLS scope spans the United States and Canada, while current provider country fields only state USA/United States; country-scope representation in the identity queue needs an explicit cross-border convention.

entries.name: Austrian Bundesliga

external_evidence.supports: Official 2026/27 basic-round schedule, beginning with LASK vs Grazer AK on 31 July 2026.
Official 2026/27 match schedule.
Official season overview: 12 clubs, 22-round home-and-away basic phase, then split into championship and qualification groups.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Bzzoiro labels the season 'Bundesliga 26/27'; LiveScoreFootball labels its season '2026'. The current audit has 15 Bzzoiro timezone-aware observations across all 12 team names and 6 unique fixtures; LiveScoreFootball has 3 timezone-aware observations across 6 teams and 3 unique fixtures. No exact cross-provider fixture overlap was established. The calendar-year label on LiveScoreFootball is consistent with the 2026 start year but does not prove its season ID covers the same full 2026/27 competition.

entries.name: Scottish Premiership

external_evidence.supports: Official Premiership fixture schedule corroborates four exact timezone-aware cross-provider fixture overlaps on 21 November 2026.
Official Premiership results and standings identify the 12-club competition.

entries.provider_season_evidence: Bzzoiro (competition 13, season 13::1355) and LiveScoreFootball (competition 735, season 735::2026) each show 12 unique teams and timezone-aware observations. Four exact UTC fixture overlaps on 21 November 2026 match the official SPFL fixture schedule in both pairing and kickoff. This strongly corroborates that the two provider competition-season records describe the same 2026/27 Scottish Premiership scope; it does not approve a canonical provider-independent identity or make provider IDs interchangeable.
